Questions

FAQ.

Who is online coaching for?

+

Athletes, swimmers, and anyone who wants structured, personalized nutrition and training guidance with real accountability.

Do you work with swimmers?

+

Yes — swimming and triathlon nutrition is a core part of my coaching, alongside my role as a technical director at a swimming club.

Do you work with children?

+

Yes, with parent or guardian involvement throughout the process.

How does online coaching work?

+

After you apply, we assess your goals and lifestyle, build your plan, then track and adjust it through regular check-ins.

How often is the plan updated?

+

Update frequency depends on your package and training phase — this is confirmed when we build your plan.

Do I need a gym?

+

Not necessarily — training plans can be adapted to your available equipment and training environment.

Can the nutrition plan fit my normal food?

+

Yes — plans are built around foods you actually eat and can sustain, not a rigid, generic list.

How do I start?

+

Fill out the application below and I'll follow up directly to discuss your goals.
